title: Nx S1
report:
**Summary:**
A fast-growing wildfire in southeastern Georgia has exceeded 31 square miles and destroyed at least 87 homes, with evacuations possible due to strong winds. The Highway 82 Fire is only 7% contained and has doubled in size overnight. A second fire about 70 miles away has burned more than 46 square miles and destroyed at least 35 homes. More crews are expected to arrive to help battle the blaze.

**Key Facts:**

1. **Fire Size**: The Highway 82 Fire has exceeded 31 square miles, while a second fire in Clinch and Echols counties has burned more than 46 square miles.
2. **Containment**: The Highway 82 Fire is only 7% contained, with officials warning of possible evacuations due to strong winds expected on Sunday.
3. **Damage**: At least 87 homes have been destroyed by the Highway 82 Fire, while a second fire has destroyed at least 35 homes.
4. **Cause**: The Highway 82 Fire was started by a foil balloon hitting live power lines, while the second fire was caused by sparks from a welding operation.
